logp.method_description: The distribution coefficient of each complex was experimentally determined by using the 'shake-flask' method as previously reported in our group. Briefly, the complexes were dissolved in a 10 mM phosphate buffer (pH 7.01) previously saturated with n-octanol to give about 1 mL of a solution with a concentration of 50 uM. The same volume of octanol (previously saturated with the buffer) was added.
